results.title: Typhoon Samuel now inside PAR, but no impact expected
results.content: Typhoon Samuel (Cempaka) will only stay briefly inside the Philippine Area of Responsibility

results.title: Philippine economic growth slows further to 2.1% in Q3 2026
results.content: (1st UPDATE) The latest GDP figure is even lower than the revised 2.4% growth recorded in Q2 2026, and also below the revised 4% posted in Q3 2025
